verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent, so showing license and public-code matching references for its suggestions is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any license detection, public-code matching, or code-referencing feature. The diff review, raw debugger reports and page-cited embedded docs MCP are different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code
